t: Formed on 1 July 1867 by the union of British colonies, with John A. Macdonald as its first prime minister.
It grew by purchase and union into the world’s second-largest country, tied together by the Canadian Pacific Railway.
It won full independence gradually, through the Statute of Westminster of 1931 and the Constitution Act, 1982.
dyk: Ottawa was chosen as capital of the Province of Canada by Queen Victoria in 1857, partly as a compromise between the rival cities of Toronto, Kingston, Montreal and Quebec.
ev: The Charlottetown and Quebec conferences agree the terms of Confederation
The British North America Act creates the Dominion of Canada on 1 July
Canada acquires Rupert’s Land and creates the province of Manitoba
The Canadian Pacific Railway is completed and Louis Riel is executed
The Canadian Corps captures Vimy Ridge
The Statute of Westminster confirms Canada’s legislative independence
Newfoundland joins Canada as the tenth province
The Constitution Act patriates the constitution and adds the Charter of Rights and Freedoms
